<EvidenceAnchor id="int-umw-ao3401a-netlist" />

### int-umw-ao3401a-pdo3-exposure

<EvidenceAnchor id="int-umw-ao3401a-pdo3-exposure" />

- **Records involved:** `rec-umw-ao3401a-c347476` (this record)
- **Conditions:** Epic-investigation finding: on a factory-default (unreprogrammed) STUSB4500 NVM, PDO3 (20 V) has highest priority and a 20 V-capable PD source negotiates it before any 15V-only reprogram is applied (doc/src/content/docs/inbox/nvm-programming.md). With VBEN asserted and VBUS\_IN at 20 V, the Q1 gate divider (R11 100k/R12 56k) puts Vgs at approximately -12.82 V (fact-umw-ao3401a-vgs-pdo3-margin), exceeding the AO3401A's +/-12 V gate absolute maximum (fact-umw-ao3401a-vgs) by about 0.82 V. This bundle records the numbers only; the wave-6 decision task decides the provision (NVM reprogram-before-first-attach gate, a resistor-value change, an added clamp/limiter, or another mitigation).
- **Verdict:** NEEDS BENCH

**Facts this rests on:**

- [`fact-umw-ao3401a-vgs`](#fact-umw-ao3401a-vgs)
- [`fact-umw-ao3401a-vgs-pdo3-margin`](#fact-umw-ao3401a-vgs-pdo3-margin)

| `PROJECT_STATE`         | A value this project recorded about how the part is used here — a chosen operating point, a net assignment, or a derived figure. Not a manufacturer specification. |
| `THERMAL_SOA`           | Thermal and safe-operating-area behaviour: how much the part may dissipate, and under what mounting and ambient conditions.                                        |
